question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is the **"those".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• If we refer to the line "This is a **matter** of great hope and relief for (3) ______ who understand the value of (4) ______ wildlife and the environment
 
• Here, "who" is working as a relative pronoun
 
• Relative Pronoun "Who" refers to a person
